basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old software developer originally from Leuven, Belgium, currently exploring options to relocate due to high taxation and shifting cultural values. My interests include European politics, economic theories, and modding Minecraft in my free time. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility of remote work, which allows me to be online during late evenings. My current focus is on understanding different European tax regimes and finding a community that aligns more closely with my libertarian values.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from KU Leuven. My interest in politics and economics developed through online courses and active participation in forums. I've gained extensive knowledge about European tax policies and libertarian principles through self-study and discussion with like-minded individuals on Reddit.
